texto:
Many people today spend hours looking at screens. We use our phones, computers, and tablets for work, school, and fun. A 'digital detox' is a period when you decide to stop using these electronic devices. It doesn't have to be for a long time; it can be for just a few hours, a full day, or even a weekend. The main goal is to take a break from the constant notifications and information that our devices give us.

Taking a break from technology has many benefits. When you are not looking at a screen, your mind can relax. Many people find they can focus better on other activities, like reading a book or talking with family. It can also help you sleep better because the blue light from screens can affect our sleep. Instead of checking emails, you could go for a walk in nature. A digital detox is a simple way to improve your well-being and connect with the world around you.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what is one benefit of a digital detox?

opciones.A: It helps you finish your work faster on the computer.
opciones.B: It is a good way to watch more online videos.
opciones.C: It can help you improve your sleep.
opciones.D: It is only for people who live in nature.
opciones.E: It makes you more popular on social media.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque el texto menciona explícitamente este beneficio. The text says, 'It can also help you sleep better because the blue light from screens can affect our sleep'. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. A es incorrecta porque el detox implica no usar el ordenador. B y E son contrarias al propósito de un detox. D es incorrecta porque el texto sugiere 'go for a walk in nature' como una actividad, no como un requisito.

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, we can infer that...

opciones.A: A digital detox must last for at least one week.
opciones.B: Using electronic devices all the time can be stressful.
opciones.C: Reading books is the only activity you can do during a detox.
opciones.D: Blue light from screens is good for our eyes.
opciones.E: Most people do not own any electronic devices.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B. El texto no lo dice explícitamente, pero podemos deducirlo. The text states that a digital detox helps your mind to 'relax' and is a 'break from the constant notifications'. This implies that the constant use of devices and receiving notifications is not relaxing, and can therefore be stressful. Las otras opciones son incorrectas: A es falsa, el texto dice que puede durar 'just a few hours'; C es falsa, el texto también menciona 'talking with family' o 'go for a walk'; D es incorrecta, se menciona que la luz azul 'can affect our sleep', lo cual es negativo; y E es lo contrario de lo que sugiere la primera frase del texto.
